messages:
Asha Patel: Need a final pass on tri-mode site copy today. Key deliverables: hero line, three short CTAs, webinar landing + routing rules, and post-signup flow.
Miguel Torres: I'll own launch posts and timeline. Hero should stress predictable inference economics, not model laundry list.
Samira Chen: Dropped three micro-hero options in the doc. Voting poll: 1) "Predictable inference for production apps" 2) "One API. Any deployment. Predictable inference." 3) "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost."
Jules Park: CTAs I recommend: "Start Hosted" / "Reserve Dedicated" / "Deploy Private". Short and mappable to deployment_interest.
Nina O'Connor: SEO check: use "inference API" and "LLM inference platform." Avoid "hosting." Add canonical to /deployments and use "deployment options" H2.
Samira Chen: Webinar landing form fields: name, company, email, est_monthly_tokens, deployment_interest (hosted|dedicated|private). Routing pseudocode to add to dev ticket:
```
payload = {"lead_type": "webinar", "email": email, "company": company, "est_tokens": tokens, "deployment_interest": deployment_choice, "utm_source": utm_source, "original_cta": cta}
if payload.est_tokens >= 15000 || payload.deployment_interest == "dedicated":
  route = "sales@redwood.com"
else:
  route = "growth-sdr@redwood.com"
if payload.original_cta == "Reserve Dedicated":
  payload.enterprise_interest = "true"
```
Miguel Torres: Also tag every lead with deployment_interest derived from CTA click for clean analytics. If enterprise_interest=true trigger the high-touch email sequence.
Jules Park: Short microcopy for Dedicated card: "Reserved GPU pools and SLA-backed latency targets. Predictable throughput for production workloads. Contact sales for capacity pricing." Tooltip: "Reserved capacity, predictable p99 latency."
Nina O'Connor: CRM keys to standardize in webhook: lead_type, deployment_interest, enterprise_interest, est_tokens, lead_source, original_cta. Use exact keys for mapping.
Samira Chen: Post-signup sequence: 1) instant confirmation + quickstart + benchmarks PDF; 2) day-before reminder; 3) follow-up with migration playbook + CTA for dedicated trial. If enterprise_interest=true include SSO context and demo request link.
Asha Patel: Deadline: lock hero + CTAs + webhook snippet in ticket by EOD Thu so staging goes out Fri. Samira drop PR when ready.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy scheduled Fri 16:00 UTC if PR merged by 15:30 UTC.
Miguel Torres: Copying social timeline into the doc now.
Samira Chen: Opening PR shortly and tagging reviewers.
Asha Patel: Thanks all — keep comments tight, we'll iterate post-launch based on webinar metrics.
